subject: Piece of Heart [022]
text: Riding the Magic Bean plant above Dodongo's Cavern allows Link to jump off to the north and collect PIECE OF HEART [022].

evidence.quote: When you get up to Dodongo's Cavern, get onto the Magic Bean plant and ride it up. Jump off to the north almost immediately above the cave and grab the PIECE OF HEART [022] which was sitting up there.

subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [055]
text: Playing the Scarecrow Song in Dodongo's Cavern summons a scarecrow that Link can Hookshot to in order to reach GOLD SKULLTULA [055].

evidence.quote: Play the Scarecrow Song while standing beside it and a scarecrow will appear up there. Stand back and shoot your Hookshot to grab onto the scarecrow and get up there, now you can snag GOLD SKULLTULA [055].

subject: small treasure chest
text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the circle of stones outside Goron City reveals a hole with a chest containing a HUGE RUPEE.

evidence.quote: In front of the entrance there is a circle of stones and when you stand in the middle of this circle you should be able to feel the controller rumble. Instead of setting down a bomb here, what you want to do is take out your Ocarina and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up). Suddenly a hole will appear underneath you and you'll drop down to an area with a small treasure chest, inside this chest is a HUGE RUPEE.

subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [056]
text: Crossing one of the suspended ropes in Goron City reveals GOLD SKULLTULA [056] on the back of the platform, obtainable using the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Cross one of the ropes which will give you a view of the back of that panel and there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [056] on the back, you can get it using your Hookshot.

subject: Goron
text: Stopping the rolling Goron with a bomb and asking about both dialogue options rewards Link with the heat-resistant GORON TUNIC.

evidence.quote: Equip your bombs and drop one so that it explodes as he rolls over it, then he'll begin to talk to you. Speak to him again and he'll go on about the Fire Temple, then start crying. At that point you have to ask him about both options which appear, one after the other. Once you do that the Goron gives you the GORON TUNIC which is heat-resistant and will allow you to pass through really hot areas like the Death Mountain Crater without worrying about burning to death.

subject: giant Goron
text: A giant Goron on the same floor sells the GIANT'S KNIFE, though the weapon breaks easily after very little use.

evidence.quote: Take the southwest path on this same floor and it will lead you to a giant Goron, it seems he has recently finished his weapon and he is willing to sell you the GIANT'S KNIFE, a new weapon for Link. You may think this is great, however the knife will break quite easily after very little use, so what you want to do is just let it sit in your inventory for now, we'll utilize its power later when it will be more useful.

subject: statue
text: Dragging backward the statue in Darunia's room reveals the secret path leading into the Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Enter Darunia's room, the one to the north at the very bottom of the city and grab hold of the statue at the top of the room. Drag it backward and this will reveal the secret path leading into the Death Mountain Crater.

subject: Link
text: Crossing the collapsed bridge in Death Mountain Crater using the Hookshot triggers a scene where Link learns the BOLERO OF FIRE.

evidence.quote: Equip your Hookshot and shoot it at the pole just ahead of you, this will pull you across to the complete section of the bridge. As you start walking forward a scene occurs where you learn the BOLERO OF FIRE.

subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [057]
text: Dropping bugs into the small soft soil hole in Death Mountain Crater causes GOLD SKULLTULA [057] to emerge.

evidence.quote: Approach the small hole just beside you and drop the bugs into it, a GOLD SKULLTULA [057] will pop out of the hole for you to defeat.

subject: Magic Bean plant
text: Riding the grown Magic Bean plant in Death Mountain Crater allows Link to hop off and collect PIECE OF HEART [023].

evidence.quote: Step onto the Magic Bean plant which is now fully grown and it will lift you up, after a couple of seconds you'll pass by the PIECE OF HEART [023] which you can get simply by hopping off and picking up.

subject: Magic Bean plant
text: Riding the Magic Bean plant in Death Mountain Crater also passes Piece of Heart [008] for players who missed it earlier.

evidence.quote: If you stay on the platform it also takes you past Piece of Heart [008] which was somewhat difficult to get, so if you missed it before you can get it quite easily now.

subject: small treasure chest
text: Pressing the button in Darunia's room opens the cage where a Goron is trapped, revealing a small treasure chest containing a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: Keep jumping across until you reach a button which opens the gate beside you. Speak to the Goron in the cage and then open the small treasure chest behind him to acquire a SMALL KEY.

subject: small treasure chest
text: Bombing the door on the right side of the enormous room and hitting the button inside frees a Goron and reveals a small chest with a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: When you get to the door on the right side, take out one of your bombs and place it in front of the door. Head through the door and step on the buttons which opens up the cage. Speak to the Goron inside and then open the small treasure chest behind him to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: small chest
text: Opening the cage on the opposite side of the room allows Link to open a small chest behind the Goron to receive another SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: Return to the previous room and head across to the opposite side, there is a normal door there which leads to a hall and a cage with another Goron inside, open the cage and speak to him. Open the small chest behind him to get yet another SMALL KEY.

subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [058]
text: Playing the Song of Time creates a blue block leading to an upper room where defeating the Like Like lets Link kill GOLD SKULLTULA [058].

evidence.quote: Notice that outside of this hall, above the door that you just went through is one of those blue blocks. Stand near it and take out your Ocarina, play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and the block appears right in front of you. Climb up on top of the block and proceed through the door up top here...When the monster has been defeated then you can kill the GOLD SKULLTULA [058].

subject: block
text: Pushing the block over the edge onto the ground and jumping on it causes a blast of fire to launch the block up into another room.

evidence.quote: Drop down onto the pillar and push the block over the edge. Wait until the block is safely on the ground and then jump down onto it. There will be a blast of fire which launches it up into another room, use your Small Key and continue.

subject: crystal
text: Dropping a bomb onto the crystal temporarily extinguishes the fire on the fence so Link can climb up before the fire returns.

evidence.quote: Stop at the first platform and move over so that you are above that crystal thing, what you need to do is take out a bomb, drop it on the crystal and then quickly climb up to the fence which is on fire. Climb it quickly before the crystal returns to its original state and the fire returns.

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the button in the enclosed area of the rolling boulder room frees a Goron and reveals a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

evidence.quote: If you stay along the wall eventually you will come to a little enclosed area with a door, head through the door and step on the button to open up the cage for the Goron, then get the SMALL KEY from the chest behind the Goron.

subject: GOLD SKULLTULA [059]
text: Striking the dead end wall in the rolling boulder room until it makes a different noise and blasting it with a bomb reveals GOLD SKULLTULA [059].

evidence.quote: Strike the wall here with your sword until it makes a different noise, then pull out your bombs and blast the wall. In here you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [059].

subject: small treasure chest
text: Stepping on a button in front of another cage in the boulder room frees a Goron and yields another SMALL KEY from the small treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Eventually you should come across a cage with a button in front of it, step on the button to open the cage and then speak to the Goron. Open the small treasure chest behind him to get another SMALL KEY.

subject: large treasure chest
text: Climbing over the metal gate past the moving wall of fire allows Link to drop down to a large treasure chest containing the DUNGEON MAP.

evidence.quote: Instead of going through the door however, note the metal gate on the other side of this ledge, you can climb over it and drop down to a large treasure chest which contains the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.
